title: 第十八章 境界论说吸星叹逍遥第四章 武当小师叔
content_zh:
令狐海：【武道大致境界，刚才已经说了，我就详细说说是如何划分的】
令狐海：【实际上很简单。学些庄稼把式，简单的剑招，修炼一些外功，能轻而易举地对付几个普通人，这是不入流】
令狐海：【修炼出内劲，引气归元，融入丹田，就为三流之境。三流是养气，逐渐的壮大真气，达到一定程度，拧成一股，然后经过功法引导，可以开辟十二正经。】
令狐海：【开辟十二正经，就为二流之境。这需要经脉知识，穴位辨认，否则哪怕有功法，最好也别修炼，否则容易走火入魔】
令狐海：【一流之境，是开辟奇经八脉】
令狐海：【更进一步，贯通任督二脉，形成体内周天大循环，真气运转不休，周行不怠，此为绝顶】
令狐海：【绝顶之上是什么境界，我就不知道了】
令狐海：【这些境界，看似简单，可实际上非常困难。哪怕只是三流之境的养气，也要不停的淬炼，壮大真气，耗时日久】
令狐海：【真气哪里来？是从食物中提炼，若是生存条件差，最好别修炼，否则能将自己练死】
令狐海：【这也是穷文富武的根本原因，没有条件，修炼武道，就是找死】
令狐海：【养气就千难万难了，更进一步开辟十二正经，是难上加难。经脉淤堵，需要真气一点点地消磨，一点点地冲击，还要小心别将经脉给冲毁撕裂了。真气强了不行，弱了也不行，需要时时小心，日夜打磨，这是个苦活累活，还需要营养跟得上】
令狐海：【当初我在华山，因为有大功，得师尊青睐，专门指点，也给药膳滋补，才一步步提升上来】
令狐海：【指点，功法，药膳等我都有，也没经历过太大的波折，就这，到了如今，也才开辟三条正经而已】
令狐海：【你们应该知道，我看到叶兄达到一流境界有多么震惊了吧】
令狐海：【匪夷所思】
林凡默默地看着。
也想到了第一轮的三个世界：笑傲江湖，小李飞刀，神雕侠侣。
首先排除小李飞刀。
因为只回来一个，已经暴露过。
“笑傲江湖和神雕侠侣这两个世界，如何能让没有任何基础的人，在短短三年的时间修炼到一流之境？”

“吸星大法！”
“令狐海应该能猜到，甚至知道叶恒的存在，却还如此爆料修炼难度，不安好心啊！”
“叶恒这位，更不好惹。”
林凡心中复杂。
本以为他依靠知道剧情的关系，已经机缘深厚，可以俯视其它降临者。
如今排名一出。
犹如当头棒喝。
“这个世界，从不缺少天才，更不缺少聪明人。”
林凡又想到一点。
排名前列的这些二流高手，基本上可以确定是二轮降临者。
他看到宋青书已经盘坐修炼，也没打扰，轻轻站起身走向了后山。
老张在那边。
黑风寨。
大堂之上，这里坐着一位黑衣青年，神情冷冽，目光却好似透着迷茫。
两旁却站着不少人，大气不敢出。
其中就有三位当家。
到现在还鼻青脸肿。
content_en:
Linghu Hai: [The general realm of martial arts has been mentioned just now, I will explain in detail how it is divided]
Linghu Hai: [It’s actually very simple. Learn some crop tricks, simple sword moves, practice some external skills, and be able to easily deal with a few ordinary people, this is not the best]
Linghu Hai: [Cultivation of inner strength, bringing the energy back to the origin, and integrating into the Dantian is the third-rate state. The third level is to nourish the Qi, gradually strengthen the Qi, reach a certain level, twist it into one, and then through the guidance of the exercises, the twelve main meridians can be opened. 】
Linghu Hai: [Opening up the twelve canons is a second-rate realm. This requires knowledge of meridians and identification of acupuncture points. Otherwise, even if there are exercises, it is best not to practice them, otherwise it is easy to go crazy]
Linghu Hai: [The first-rate state is to open up the eight extraordinary meridians]
Linghu Hai: [Go one step further and connect the Ren and Du meridians to form a great circulation around the body. The true energy circulates endlessly and circulates without slackness. This is the pinnacle]
Linghu Hai: [I don’t know what realm is above the extreme]
Linghu Hai: [These realms may seem simple, but are actually very difficult. Even if you are only cultivating Qi in the third-rate realm, you still need to constantly temper and strengthen your Qi, which takes a long time]
Linghu Hai: [Where does the true energy come from? It is extracted from food. If the living conditions are poor, it is best not to practice, otherwise you can practice to death]
Linghu Hai: [This is also the fundamental reason why the poor in literature and rich in martial arts are poor. Without conditions, practicing martial arts is seeking death]
Linghu Hai: [It is extremely difficult to cultivate qi, and it is even more difficult to further develop the twelve canons. When the meridians are blocked, the true energy needs to be consumed little by little and impacted little by little, and one must be careful not to destroy and tear the meridians. It’s not enough if the Qi is strong, it’s not enough if it’s weak. You need to be careful all the time and polish it day and night. This is hard work and tiring work, and you also need nutrition to keep up.]
Linghu Hai: [When I was in Huashan, because of my great merits, I was favored by my master, who gave me special guidance and nourishing food and medicine, so I was promoted step by step]
Linghu Hai: [I have advice, exercises, medicinal diet, etc., and I haven’t experienced too many twists and turns. That’s it. Until now, I have only opened up three serious ways]
Linghu Hai: [You should know how shocked I was to see Brother Ye reach the first-class level]
Linghu Hai: [Incredible]
Lin Fan watched silently.
I also thought of the three worlds in the first round: Swordsman, Xiao Li Fei Dao, and The Legend of the Condor Heroes.
First exclude Xiao Li's flying knife.
Because only one came back, it has been exposed.
"How can the two worlds of The Swordsman and The Legend of the Condor Heroes allow people with no foundation to cultivate to a first-class level in just three years?"
"The magic of attracting stars!"
"Linghu Hai should be able to guess and even know Ye Heng's existence, but he still reveals the difficulty of training like this. How uneasy and kind!"
"Ye Heng is even more difficult to mess with."
Lin Fan felt complicated.
I thought that because he knew the plot, he had a good chance and could look down on the other descendants.
Now the rankings are out.
It was like a wake-up call.
"This world never lacks geniuses, let alone smart people."
Lin Fan thought of something else.
These second-rate masters at the top of the rankings can basically be determined to be second-round arrivals.
He saw that Song Qingshu was already sitting cross-legged practicing, so he didn't bother him and gently stood up and walked towards the back mountain.
Lao Zhang is over there.
Black Wind Village.
Above the lobby, there is a young man in black sitting here, with a cold expression, but his eyes seem to be confused.
There were many people standing on both sides, and they didn't dare to show their anger.
There are three heads among them.
I still have a bruised nose and a swollen face.
